D04_reference.observable: lowest zero-momentum valence isovector pseudoscalar energy on S16T16 quenched Wilson, kappa=0.14
D04_reference.physical_interpretation: independent target for the dimensionless Pion fixed-protocol risk objective
D04_reference.reference_method: candidate-blind joint two-state PP(n=0,8,16)+local A4P spectral fit
D04_reference.data_source: independent E-chain; correlator receipt not yet supplied
D04_reference.pass_rule: relative mass error<=0.05; p>=0.01; PP/A4P and window/model shifts<=2.5 paired SE; no boundary hits
D04_reference.failure_rule: any failed reference gate makes D04 unresolved; do not substitute synthetic operator loss

D06_effect_threshold.direction_and_interpretation: rho=R_comparator/R_trainableW; rho>1 favors trainable-W; require at least 10% risk reduction
D06_effect_threshold.decision_rule: hull lower bound across block lengths must exceed r_star for both comparisons
D06_effect_threshold.invalid_or_zero_risk_rule: ABSTAIN_RATIO_UNDEFINED; do not add epsilon or change to an absolute-difference estimand

D11_strong_spectral_operator.basis_parameterization: monotone Bernstein controls mapped by a fixed exact dyadic rational degree-4 transform, evaluated in float64, to a Chebyshev series for Clenshaw application
D11_strong_spectral_operator.H_definition: H=sum_i(T_i+T_i^dagger-2I), three periodic spatial directions, equal-weight unitary 3x3 links
D11_strong_spectral_operator.identity_normalization: P4(1)=b4=1 at the zero mode; outer unnormalized G^2 P4(H) G^2 is common to all arms
D11_strong_spectral_operator.positivity_projection_constraints: Bernstein basis gives 0<=P4<=1; monotone controls imply dP4/dy>=0; no post-fit clipping or projection
D11_strong_spectral_operator.failure_rule: reject nonunitary links, wrong shape/boundary, nonfinite values, or infeasible controls; never repair by clipping

selected_fair_budget_defaults.initialization_policy: freeze and hash one prespecified initialization plan; use matched starts where parameterizations permit
selected_fair_budget_defaults.restart_policy: one prespecified start per arm; no unbudgeted restarts; retain failed runs in assigned-arm denominator
selected_fair_budget_defaults.stopping_rule: stop at 160 objective/gradient calls or the prespecified solver tolerance; count all objective and gradient evaluations
selected_fair_budget_defaults.hardware_environment: not yet measured; record CPU/GPU model, thread count, precision, software versions and clock policy
selected_fair_budget_defaults.walltime_rule: charge full training/setup/selection cost to one task until a supported deployment task count and cost ledger exist

hopping_operator: H psi(x)=sum_i[U_i(x)psi(x+i)+U_i(x-i)^dagger psi(x-i)-2psi(x)] over three spatial directions
spectrum: H is Hermitian with spectrum in [-12,0]; X=I+H/6 has spectrum in [-1,1]; y=I+H/12 has spectrum in [0,1]
polynomial: P4(y)=sum_i b_i C(4,i)y^i(1-y)^(4-i); equivalently sum_k a_k T_k(2y-1)
application: five Clenshaw operator matvecs; CPU matrix-free P4 and unnormalized G^m P4(H) G^m candidates use the periodic hopping kernel without an eigensolver; GPU/train.main integration is not implemented
coefficient_fit_helper: fit_control_points_slsqp accepts a fixed scalar objective callback, constrains four free Bernstein controls with b4=1, enforces a hard objective-call cap, and returns solver status and best feasible controls; it has no D04 objective wired in
comparison_contract: Use the selected common outer G^2 P4(H) G^2 sandwich, candidate-blind D04 risk/reference, common fit IDs and precision, full failure accounting, and paired evaluation; fit the four Bernstein controls on fit IDs only; charge basis/application, all solver calls, walltime, setup and selection cost to this arm.
open_gates: independent E-chain D04 reference data and receipt
empirical paired-risk and full-cost receipts for the two selected comparisons
data-owner and GPU/QUDA authorization for production runs
